reference_sql:
WITH price_points AS (
  SELECT list_price_eur AS price_eur
  FROM price_history
  WHERE product_id = 5
  UNION ALL
  SELECT price_eur
  FROM competitor_prices
  WHERE product_id = 5
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS price_points
FROM price_points
alternatives: WITH list_prices AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM price_history WHERE product_id = 5), checks AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM competitor_prices WHERE product_id = 5) SELECT l.n + c.n AS price_points FROM list_prices l CROSS JOIN checks c
WITH price_points AS (SELECT product_id FROM price_history UNION ALL SELECT product_id FROM competitor_prices) SELECT COUNT(*) AS price_points FROM price_points WHERE product_id = 5

other_way.sql: WITH list_prices AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM price_history WHERE product_id = 5), checks AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM competitor_prices WHERE product_id = 5) SELECT l.n + c.n AS price_points FROM list_prices l CROSS JOIN checks c
other_way.tradeoff: Counting each table in its own CTE and adding the two counts gives the same number without stacking any rows.
